purpose: Make normal directory save ownership match the deployed readDirectoryFlow/storyDirectory rule: only a scene's own document supplies its authoritative chart row.

minimumChanges.replaceDirectoryBranch: Resolve prior edge/source identity, then ensure only that scene's own native source is available. Return from the directory branch before the global foreign-chart scan. If already loaded, do not read more sources. Target is metadata/read-only.
minimumChanges.deleteById: For delete_edge with only id, recover source from the prior saved/generated directory edge. If its owner is outside initial scope, read that owner only at snapshot.headSha. Do not scan every document that contains a copied chart row.
minimumChanges.preserveOtherOperations: Keep node/delete and scenario renumbering's real incoming-FINISH scan unchanged.

minimumChanges.replaceMutationLoop: Select snapshot.sources.find(source.entry.id===sourceId), then update only its chartmap.scene_list row with scene_id===sourceId. Never loop through foreign documents, never replace all155 chart rows.
minimumChanges.identity: Preserve explicit author edge id. A pre-existing edge source should remain fixed, as in the current UI; reject source relocation rather than silently writing another owner.
minimumChanges.redirect: Use prior.nativeTarget/evidence.nativeTarget to find the old pair in the owner row, replace only that item while preserving any extra native target fields. Duplicate same-pair additions retain current deduplication behavior.
minimumChanges.delete: Remove only the matching owner target. Preserve prior source/nativeTarget/evidence in the saved deleted tombstone so storyDirectory can suppress regenerated native counterparts using the same author identity.
minimumChanges.missingOwner: Do not create a body/chart row or adopt a foreign copy. Existing explicit manual directory metadata may remain extras-only; surface missing own-source coverage. This boundary requires review but is not exercised by the10090015 candidate.
minimumChanges.sectionEdges: Keep section-source edges extras-only; they must not touch any native scene body.
minimumChanges.manualOverrides: Keep storyDirectory saved nativeTarget replacement and deleted handling unchanged. First3 manual edge identity, layout, native rows and all unrelated overrides stay guarded.
